x: George Atkinson won the sealed handicap with veteran Charlie Speechley 2nd and Alan Robins 3rd. At the White City on 3rd and 10th July respectively, Harry Churcher secured a double win in the 2 and 7 miles walks and with these following on his previous successes, we had great hopes for him at Wemble…

The following donations to general club funds have been received during the past six months from the following members, and I wish to express the thanks of the committee for their generosity:—Messrs. G.
Charlie Speechley, still having a go, won the Handicap, with George Atkinson second and Joe Scammell third. On the same day a Novices 3 miles race resulted in a win for E.
Incidentally, George Atkinson's father was the first individual winner in this race. Bob Readman (6th) and George Bentley (11th) gave us 7 in the first 16 out of a finishing field of 66.

George Atkinson had been moved up to the "A" Team in the interests of the handicap and right well he walked. Syd James was also 2nd in the individual handicap and had what might be described as a field day.
